authorization: Explicit Owner authorization in the J8 instruction, 2026-11-16, for independent post-processing and bounded matrix-resolution diagnostics.

baseline.relation: J7 and current main have identical src/solveur Git trees. Diagnostics solve only the archived J7 global matrix; no element stiffness or load is reassembled.

model_scope.loading: total nodal force (0, 0, -1) N, distributed over the frozen nine end-face nodes
model_scope.constraints: all three translations fixed at the x=0 nodes; archived prescribed values are read from the displacement vector and used in the general partitioned equations

objectives: independently reconstruct free residuals, constrained reactions, global resultants, moments, and energy terms from the frozen J7 state
separate algebraic backward error from forward solution variation under solver and scaling changes
measure effects of stable direct solve, symmetric diagonal equilibration, and bounded iterative refinement on the same matrix and right-hand side
use an 80-decimal-digit mpmath solve for the 108-free-DOF case only; Windows longdouble was confirmed to have binary64 precision
measure the unit dependence of the historical energy normalization without changing the historical criterion
compare equation scaling with a physically consistent m-to-mm variable and stiffness-unit conversion

predeclared_formulas.partitioned_equilibrium: A = K_ff; b = f_f - K_fc u_c; r_f = K_ff u_f + K_fc u_c - f_f; reactions r_c = K_cf u_f + K_cc u_c - f_c
predeclared_formulas.roundoff_envelope: For each dot-product residual component, 4*gamma_(n+2) * (sum_j |K_ij u_j| + |f_i|), with u=2^-53 and gamma_k=k*u/(1-k*u); the factor 4 envelopes two different finite-precision reductions and the final subtraction. Compare the independent compensated sum and archived BLAS result to this envelope, reporting any exceedance rather than relaxing it.
predeclared_formulas.energy_reconstruction_envelope: For U and W separately, use four times the standard binary64 dot-product envelope. For U include both rowwise K*u dot-product rounding and the outer u dot product; for W use the outer u dot product. Compare compensated reconstructions to stored J7 values against these computed joule bounds.
predeclared_formulas.energy: J7 uses U = 0.5*u^T*K*u and W = 0.5*u^T*f for this zero-prescribed-displacement, proportionally loaded linear case. Units are joules. If prescribed support displacement is nonzero, this U/W identity is not used without including support-reaction work.
predeclared_formulas.legacy_energy_metric: abs(U-W)/max(abs(W), 1.0); reproduce exactly in SI and after numerical J-to-N-mm scaling. The literal 1.0 is a 1 J floor in the SI computation and is not unit covariant.
predeclared_formulas.prospective_energy_indicator: eta_E = abs(U-W)/max(abs(U),abs(W)); dimensionless and invariant under consistent energy-unit conversion when the denominator is nonzero. Report as a diagnostic; no acceptance threshold is introduced in J8.
predeclared_formulas.length_unit_conversion: If x_mm=1000*x_m, then K_N_per_mm=K_N_per_m/1000, f_N is unchanged, and the solved displacement is converted back by x_m=x_mm/1000 before physical metrics are evaluated.
predeclared_formulas.force_closure: F_ext = sum_i f_i; R = sum_i r_c,i; closure = F_ext + R. Use math.fsum by component and compare with the J7 reduction order.
predeclared_formulas.moment_closure: M_o = sum_i (x_i-o) x f_i + sum_i (x_i-o) x r_c,i in N m; compute at the origin and centroid, verify origin transport with the total force closure. Reproduce the frozen J7 metric ||M_0||/max(||f_nodal||_2*L_ref, 1 N m), where f_nodal is the full assembled nodal force vector (not the resultant), and report a contribution-scaled diagnostic.
predeclared_formulas.backward_error: eta_inf = ||A*x-b||_inf / (||A||_inf*||x||_inf + ||b||_inf), with residual evaluated by compensated row dot products; method indicator limit is 20*gamma_(n+1), not a physical accuracy criterion.
predeclared_formulas.iterative_refinement: Use the Cholesky factor of A; at most three corrections. Stop if eta_inf <= 20*gamma_(n+1), if the residual fails to improve by 10%, or after the third correction. Record every iterate.
predeclared_formulas.positive_definiteness: Before using positive-definite direct solvers, require the symmetric free matrix to have a positive minimum eigenvalue; if not, atomically record the reconstruction and abort the declared solver comparison.

methods: symmetric diagonal congruence scaling D*A*D*y=D*b with D_ii=1/sqrt(A_ii), then u=D*y
up to three Cholesky-based iterative-refinement corrections using compensated residuals
solve (alpha*A)x=alpha*b for alpha in {1e-6,1e6}; algebraic scaling only, not a physical change of units
solve in N/mm and mm after the exact conversion K_N_per_mm=K_N_per_m/1000, f_N unchanged, then convert displacement back to m
mpmath LU solve at 80 decimal digits for the 108-free-DOF near-degenerate matrix only

predeclared_criteria.input_sha256: must equal all frozen digests above before opening NPZ arrays
predeclared_criteria.finite_and_shape_checks: all expected arrays finite and dimensions match frozen node/DOF counts
predeclared_criteria.applied_load_resultant: recompute the nodal force sum and compare it with J7's frozen total force using its existing 1e-14 load-indicator limit; this does not alter the J7 result or verdict
predeclared_criteria.free_matrix_positive_definite: must be observed before invoking any positive-definite solve method; this is a precondition check, not a physical accuracy criterion
predeclared_criteria.zero_or_general_support_values: report max absolute prescribed displacement; always use the partitioned formula, and only report J7 energy comparability if it is zero
predeclared_criteria.residual_reconstruction: compare against the gamma roundoff envelope; never alter it after observing results
predeclared_criteria.method_completion: all declared methods must return finite vectors; if a method fails, atomically preserve the latest checkpoint and mark that method FAILED
predeclared_criteria.method_quality: report eta_inf and compare only with 20*gamma_(n+1); forward solution differences and physical metrics remain descriptive
predeclared_criteria.no_retroactive_gate: J7 scientific FAIL statuses and thresholds are immutable; J8 introduces no numerical pass/fail threshold for energy or moment

execution.semantics: Runner enforces wall-time and captured-output caps; RSS/process/temp/archive are sampled soft controls, not OS quotas.
execution.checkpoint: atomic checkpoint after independent reconstruction and after each solver method; each checkpoint preserves all earlier method records and available solution vectors before criteria evaluation

limitations: no element assembly or load integration is rerun; all method comparisons solve only the frozen J7 global matrices, so this experiment cannot rule out a common assembly or formulation error
high-precision comparison covers only the 108-free-DOF case; the 432-free-DOF case is compared with double-precision algorithms
solver-method agreement on one assembled matrix does not demonstrate physical accuracy or validate the HEX8-SRI family
no historical J7 criteria, result files, or verdicts are edited
